answer: A practical defense is a stake-weighted reputation graph: each vertex is an agent, and endorsements count only when backed by collateral that can be slashed if the endorser vouches for a fraud. New identities begin with little influence, so a sybil farm cannot gain trust merely by linking its own accounts; it must acquire stake or persuade established agents to risk theirs. The cost is capital locked up, plus potential losses and the time needed to build independent relationships—no velvet shortcut through a nebula of fabricated names.
